# Let's check each album to see if all its songs are downloaded and compute total duration.
downloaded_ids = {song['song_id'] for song in downloaded_songs}
print("All albums:")
for album in albums:
    album_id = album['album_id']
    title = album['title']
    song_ids = album['song_ids']
    all_downloaded = all(sid in downloaded_ids for sid in song_ids)
    # Compute total duration from downloaded songs that belong to this album
    total_duration = sum(song['duration'] for song in downloaded_songs if song['album_id'] == album_id)
